name: intentic
description: intentic's Claude Code plugins: the intentic bundle (trimmed output, session context, iq, fileq, measured savings) and iq on its own.

plugins.name: iq
plugins.description: Teach a coding agent to use the iq CLI (agent-native workspace search) by default over grep/find/Glob. Ships the iq skill + a SessionStart nudge. Requires the iq binary: `npm i -g @intentic/iq`.

plugins.name: intentic
plugins.description: Cheaper, sharper Claude Code sessions: Bash output trimmed before Claude reads it, a project map and this project's field notes at session start, iq code search and fileq document reading taught, document shadows kept fresh, and /intentic:stats to show what each one saved. Every mechanism is a switch in /config.
